summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip`, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB heavily-obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js` (opening `// @bun @bun-cjs`, canonical obfuscator.io string-array/`_0x` shape with rotator `WV8StW` over a shuffled const/string array). The `setup.mjs` bootstrap itself is obfuscated with hex-named identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) that indirect fs/https usage. This fires automatically on `npm install`, executing an opaque payload under an alien runtime that the package fetches itself, evading Node-based scanners. Neither the Bun runtime nor a `math_init` module is required by the package's declared purpose (an HTTP REST SDK for HitL).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
